scientific_integrity: The explicit smoothness proof and exact point counts over the first six field extensions determine the Weil polynomial by Newton identities and the genus-six functional equation. Two distinct exact finite-field counting methods corroborate these counts; formal verification and expert attestation have not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Specific plane quintic only; no classification of all Frobenius-nonclassical curves, no polarization statement. An unindexed previous Weil-polynomial computation for this named curve remains a priority risk.
title: An ordinary genus-six Frobenius-nonclassical quintic with a cubed abelian-surface Weil factor
